summary: NuRAN Wireless filed a final base shelf prospectus with Canadian authorities and a corresponding F-10 registration statement with the SEC, requesting effectiveness by August 26, 2026. This is a routine shelf registration, not a special situation. No securities are being offered at this time. Proceeds from future offerings, if any, would fund construction of over 2,000 telecom infrastructure sites. Terms, prices, and use of proceeds will be set in prospectus supplements. No deal terms are stated. Watch for future prospectus supplements for actual offerings, but this filing itself is administrative and not a special situation.
